label: Permitted audio directory
help: All audio paths must stay inside this directory. Empty uses the application root.

label: Language
help: Auto-detect or choose one of Whistle’s seven languages. French is supported.

label: Vocabulary hints
help: JSON array of names or short phrases, for example ["BloxSmith", "HackInvent"]. These are hints, not instructions.

label: Include word timestamps
help: Add word start/end times and model probabilities to the JSON output.

label: Download missing model assets
help: On first transcription only: fetch pinned official weights/engine, verify SHA-256, then reuse the block cache. Disable for offline-only use.

label: Maximum clip duration (seconds)
help: Whistle accepts at most 30 seconds per clip. Longer files are refused, never silently cut.

label: Maximum audio file size (bytes)
help: Bound the input before decoding. Default 32 MiB.

label: Processing deadline (seconds)
help: Bound local conversion and inference; Stop cancels owned processes.

label: First download deadline (seconds)
help: Additional allowance for the initial asset download. No audio is uploaded.
